features.heading: A Managed Custom Design Service — Without Managing Designers
features.intro: You sell the service. Hostopia handles everything from initial discovery through launch and optional ongoing maintenance — delivered entirely under your brand, at agency quality and partner-level margins.

cards.title: Structured Discovery & Proposal
cards.body: Every project starts with a documented discovery process and detailed proposal — so scope, timeline, and pricing are clear before work begins and expectations stay aligned.

cards.title: Mobile-Responsive, SEO-Ready Architecture
cards.body: Every site ships responsive, fast, and optimized for search engines from day one. Built to perform on every device and in every market the business targets.

cards.title: Advanced Functionality & Integrations
cards.body: Third-party APIs, custom forms, booking systems, membership areas, ecommerce — whatever the SMB's business requires, the build supports it from launch.

cards.title: WordPress Foundation with Full Ownership
cards.body: Built on WordPress, handed off with full ownership of code, content, and database. No lock-in, no licensing fees, no proprietary traps limiting future options.

cards.title: Dedicated Designer & Coordinator
cards.body: A single designer and project coordinator own the engagement end-to-end — clean communication, consistent creative direction, and predictable delivery.

cards.title: Optional Maintenance & Hosting
cards.body: Ongoing plans cover updates, backups, security patches, and hosting — turning a one-time project into recurring revenue and a durable customer relationship.

partnerAdvantage.heading: Compete with Local Agencies — Without Building One
partnerAdvantage.intro: Custom Website Design lets you serve the SMBs that outgrow templated solutions and need a higher-touch experience — without hiring a single designer or project manager.

items.title: Move upmarket without headcount
items.body: Offer premium custom builds alongside your DIY website builder and DIFM service. No designers, developers, or project managers to recruit, train, or retain — just a higher-margin tier you can sell from day one.

items.title: Bundle into higher-value packages
items.body: Custom builds pair naturally with hosting, SSL, SEO, ecommerce, and ongoing maintenance — creating multi-product engagements with stronger retention and higher lifetime value.

items.title: Position as a full-service digital partner
items.body: Offering custom design alongside your existing services signals to SMBs that you can support them at every stage of digital maturity — from first website to full digital transformation.

items.title: Capture the premium without the risk
items.body: Agency-level outcomes on Hostopia's delivery platform, with structured scoping and QA built in — so you win premium deals without inheriting the operational risk of running a creative shop.
